electric-violet.$description: Electric Violet — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Pressed and hover state of Electric Violet — used for filled-element interaction feedback and slightly deeper icon strokes

soft-lilac.$description: Soft Lilac — Light accent wash — decorative gradient stops, soft tag backgrounds, muted selected states, and atmospheric color bleeds at section edges

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, hero headlines, high-contrast icons. The strongest typographic color, reserved for content the eye should land on first

carbon.$description: Carbon — Navigation text, input borders, near-black UI surfaces, button labels. Softer than pure black so it reads as interface, not print

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body text, supporting copy, secondary labels, paragraph running text under headlines

silver.$description: Silver — Muted text, placeholders, disabled labels, captions, subtitle hierarchy. The quietest text tier, used only for de-emphasized content

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on filled violet, elevated panel backgrounds

aqua-wash.$description: Aqua Wash — Decorative gradient stop — pastel teal radial wash on hero left side, atmospheric background tint that never fills a UI element

lilac-bleed.$description: Lilac Bleed — Decorative gradient stop — pastel lavender radial wash on hero right side and section-edge color bleeds, creating depth at zero contrast cost

gilroy.$description: Primary display and brand typeface — headlines, hero copy, nav, button labels. Custom geometric sans with a friendly, designer-made personality; weight 700 at 48–62px defines the brand voice. Weight 400 is used for body and nav.

inter.$description: Secondary UI and body typeface — input text, form labels, small captions, inline metadata, and any context where Gilroy would feel too display-heavy. Reads as a neutral workhorse underneath the brand voice.

palmer-lake-print.$description: Decorative script accent — used once per page for hand-drawn section annotations (e.g. "TRY DEMO BELOW"). Carries a personal, hand-made quality that reinforces the prototyping-workshop atmosphere. Never used for functional UI.
